question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 I 组：法国 vs 伊拉克，90 分钟赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group I: France vs Iraq — 90-minute result?
one_liner_cn: Elo 差距 456 分、法国近乎全主力，法国大概率取胜；伊拉克的防守组织与极限动员只给平局留出小幅空间。
one_liner_en: With a 456-point Elo gap and a near-full-strength squad France are heavy favourites; Iraq's defensive organisation leaves only modest room for a draw.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 456 分（法国 2063 / 世界第 3 vs 伊拉克 1607 / 第 63），Davidson 模型基础胜率法国约 79%。
key_reasons.en: 456-point Elo gap (France 2063, world #3 vs Iraq 1607, #63); Davidson model baseline gives France about 79%.

key_reasons.cn: 姆巴佩伤愈入选并任队长、状态高位；法国仅缺卡马文加、埃基蒂凯等深度球员。
key_reasons.en: Mbappe recovered, included as captain and in top form; France only miss depth pieces like Camavinga and Ekitike.

key_reasons.cn: 伊拉克 40 年来首进世界杯，主帅阿诺德有 2022 世界杯执教经验、擅长低位防守，小幅抬升平局概率。
key_reasons.en: Iraq's first World Cup in 40 years under Graham Arnold, who coached at Qatar 2022 and favours a low block — a small lift to the draw.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 79.3/14.9/5.8 with a bounded evidence adjustment of 1.8pp total (cap ±8pp), renormalised. No betting or prediction-market data used.
